## Meet Musely 🎧

Waveloop has a new name and a whole new look.

**What's new**
- A fresh Material 3 design in Musely violet and lime, in light and dark mode
- A warm welcome screen and a library that greets you by the time of day
- Album grid, artist avatars and filter chips to move between Songs, Albums and Artists
- One-tap Shuffle everywhere, plus Play/Shuffle on every album and artist
- A floating mini player with live progress
- A redesigned player: breathing artwork, a morphing play button, shuffle/repeat toggles and an "Up next" peek
- New app icon from the Musely logo, including Android 13+ themed icons

**Install:** download the APK below, open it on your phone, and allow installs from your browser if asked.
